item.title: MisOr’s Janry Ubas wins silver in SEA Games long jump
item.description: Misamis Oriental’s Janry Ubas clinched the silver medal in the long jump at the 33rd Southeast Asian Games in Bangkok, Thailand. Ubas recorded a leap of 7.64 meters, finishing just behind Malaysia’s Andre Anura, who claimed gold with a jump of 7.71 meters.
